title: 2 week phase
description: Vanilla+ Minecraft modpack with create and create  addons
body:
This modpack offers an enhanced Minecraft experience that is perfect for players who want to keep the classic vanilla feeling while still enjoying many new features and possibilities. With a carefully selected mix of vanilla-plus mods, Create, and many other cool additions, this pack combines the familiar Minecraft gameplay with impressive technical, visual, and gameplay improvements.

The main idea behind this modpack is to expand the original Minecraft experience in a meaningful way without taking away its core atmosphere. The “vanilla plus” mods add new blocks, structures, mobs, and quality-of-life features that make your adventures more exciting without overwhelming the game. On top of that, there is Create, one of the most popular tech mods, allowing you to build complex machines, automated farms, and creative mechanical systems. Whether you want to create massive factories, stylish bases, or clever automation setups, Create gives you endless possibilities.

Additionally, various performance and quality-of-life mods ensure a smooth and enjoyable experience, letting you focus fully on exploring, building, and surviving. This modpack works great for both singleplayer and multiplayer worlds and offers the perfect blend of technology, adventure, and classic Minecraft feeling.
